result.how: temporary trigger flows on the dev instance (2026-09-21), subscriptions inspected with MakeApiCall GET /subscriptions
result.note: start() created a chatMessage subscription with changeType created, the lifecycle URL set and expiration start + 4320 minutes, which Graph accepted. A message from another user (test admin bunny) fired the trigger within about a second, with ignoreOwnMessages on and off. The user own message fired only the flow with ignoreOwnMessages off; the default flow skipped it. A message edited afterwards (reactions) was emitted once. stop() deleted the subscription. Left running overnight (about 15.5 hours, until 2026-09-22 07:07 UTC): the subscription stayed active with its original expiry and no errors were logged; Graph sent no lifecycle event in that time. Not verified live: renewal (fires 5 minutes before the 72-hour expiry) and lifecycle events (sent by Graph on its own schedule); both are unit tested
